设计意图： Simplified adaptive regime-switching factor: in uptrend (close above 20-day SMA) use 10-day momentum, otherwise use intraday mean reversion (open-close)/open. Removes volatility normalization to reduce noise and target improved IC and MI while preserving the core economic intuition of the parent and RankIC stability.

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-(if close > SMA20 then (close/ts_delay(close, 10)-1) else ((open-close)/open))
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where((AdjClose > ts_mean(AdjClose, 20)), subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 10)), 1), divide(subtract(AdjOpen, AdjClose), AdjOpen))
  2. 2. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(AdjClose, 20)
  3. 3. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 10)), 1)
  4. 4. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 10))
  5. 5. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 10)
  6. 6. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(AdjOpen, AdjClose), AdjOpen)
  7. 7. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjOpen, AdjClose)
使用字段：
列含义说明
AdjClose后复权收盘复权后的收盘价，动量/收益类计算常用
AdjOpen后复权开盘复权后的开盘价

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 sma20：close.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  2. 计算 mom：close / close.shift(10) - 1
  3. 计算 rev：(open - close) / open
  4. 计算 trend_up：close > sma20
  5. 计算 factor：np.where(trend_up, mom, rev)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_regime_switch_simple(df): df_copy = df.copy() sma20 = df_copy["str">'close'].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() mom = df_copy["str">'close'] / df_copy["str">'close'].shift(10) - 1 rev = (df_copy["str">'open'] - df_copy["str">'close']) / df_copy["str">'open'] trend_up = df_copy["str">'close'] > sma20 factor = np.where(trend_up, mom, rev) df_copy["str">'factor_regime_switch_simple'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_regime_switch_simple']
